prompt: Create a new named spell page from scratch for Ledgerbind — a 1st-level abjuration that briefly seals a written contract or ship's log against tampering, with a visible ink-frost tell. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/spell.md. Do not treat spell-scroll item pages as spell pages. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
expected_output: A new spell page labeled invention:true that follows spell.md, with identity sentence, narration, full 2024 block, and runnable effect. No claim Ledgerbind exists in vault canon; no spell-scroll item cited as a spell exemplar.

assertions.text: Frontmatter includes type: spell, level, school, ritual, and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Does not cite spell-scroll item pages as type: spell pages
Casting Time, Range, Components, and Duration are filled in 2024 terms
Runnable effect states what sealing does, how long, how it fails/ends, and any save or check — not vague 'protects the document'
